note: Export side is factually supported: dated customs lines with B/L numbers (7781088, 7768924, 7748396, 7716066, 7697420), destinations Busan (South Korea) and Abu Dhabi/Nhava Sheva lanes, HS 39014090 / 39023000 / 39021000 — i.e. the declared HS 390810 (polyamides) does not match the observed polymer codes (ethylene-propylene copolymers, polypropylene, polyolefin elastomer); per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground, HS should be corrected to the actual observed codes. Note the free ImportKey view mixes import and export legs (many rows are Abu Dhabi -> Nhava Sheva inbound), so the 2501 figure is not an export-only count; only the SHIPPER-side rows above are export evidence. Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, annual-report India/export split) could not be retrieved: web_search returned connection errors on every attempt and thecompanycheck/eximpedia/volza returned HTTP 403. Revenue and export volume figures: null — not public in accessible sources, not invented. No rejection grounds: entity is active in customs data as of 2026-02-27.
